'''2007 Endor Regionals Spencer Gosiaco DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Spencer Gosiaco]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Bombers
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
